steps.summary: Successfully opened the "Service Health" provisioned dashboard (at /d/bench-service-health/service-health). The dashboard displays 3 panels in order: (1) Request rate, (2) Error count, (3) Latency by endpoint. All panel titles were confirmed from the live DOM.

Created a new dashboard in Grafana with a Stat panel using the TestData data source (default Random Walk scenario), titled the panel "rpgr7-r2 Availability", and saved the dashboard as "rpgr7-r2 Bench Dashboard" (General folder). Verified on screen after saving: dashboard title "rpgr7-r2 Bench Dashboard" and panel title "rpgr7-r2 Availability" (showing A-series value 66.4).

Opened the "rpgr7-r2 Bench Dashboard" and added a new Text panel. Set the panel title to "rpgr7-r2 Notes" and entered markdown content reading "Notes for run rpgr7-r2 - bench dashboard created via automation." Saved the dashboard (no default time range change). After saving, the dashboard shows both panels: "rpgr7-r2 Availability" (Stat, value 43.3) and "rpgr7-r2 Notes" (Text, displaying the notes content).
